title: Enjoy your stay (FCP 2026)
synopsis: To avoid losing custody of her daughter in Manila, Luz (35), an undocumented Filipino cleaner in the luxury chalets of Verbier, must pay off her debt and collect money at any cost — even if it means betraying her community and crossing her own moral limits.

synopsis_lang.en: To avoid losing custody of her daughter in Manila, Luz (35), an undocumented Filipino cleaner in the luxury chalets of Verbier, must pay off her debt and collect money at any cost — even if it means betraying her community and crossing her own moral limits.
synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 三十五歲，沒有工作簽證的菲律賓女子Luz在韋爾比耶區豪華渡假屋任清潔工。為了避免失去在馬尼拉的女兒的監護權，她必須還清債務，並不惜一切代價湊錢——即使這意味著背叛自己的同胞，跨越自身的道德底線。

cast: Mercedes Cabral, Alexis Manenti, Anna Luna, Hasmine Killip
